draft.title: Farming in Australia
card: Wheat

Australia grows wheat in a belt inland of the coast, such as the Wheatbelt of Western Australia and the plains of western Victoria and New South Wales. These areas have fairly flat land and moderate rainfall, mostly in the cooler months.
Irrigation
The Murray-Darling Basin is Australia's main irrigation region. Water from its rivers is spread over crops such as rice, cotton and fruit in places where rain alone is too low or too unreliable.
Cattle
Beef cattle are run across the north, on very large stations. The land is too dry or too rough for crops, but cattle can graze on it over a wide area.
Exports
Australia has a small population compared with its farm output, so it sells much of what it produces overseas. Wheat and beef are two products that are exported in large amounts.
draft.remember: Each farming type suits the land and water of its region, and much of the output is exported.

a.q: Why are beef cattle run on large stations across northern Australia?
opts: The land suits grazing over wide areas more than crops
The north has the most reliable irrigation water
The north has the flattest land and cool, wet winters
The north is close to most of the farm's customers
a.why: Cattle can graze on large areas of dry or rough land where crops would not grow well. The north does not have the reliable irrigation water in the option that sounds tempting, as irrigation is linked to the Murray-Darling Basin.
a.clue: Think about land that is too dry or rough for crops.

b.q: Mia grows rice and cotton on a farm in the Murray-Darling Basin. Why does she rely on irrigation?
opts: Rain alone is too low or unreliable for these crops
The land is too steep for the crops to grow
The crops are grown only for export
The Basin is too far inland to have any rivers
b.why: Irrigation spreads river water over crops where rain alone is too low or unreliable. Exports are a different matter: they say where the food is sold, not how it is watered.
b.clue: Irrigation adds water that rain does not supply.

wants.why: It shows where each type of farming sits on the continent.
